# Fourteenth pass (generated by scripts/make_stats_p21.py; pre-registered in LOG.md)

## A. Causal test of the support direction (18 DTU benchmark scans, 5 views; exploratory, no pass rule)

One direction per hooked layer (mean supported token minus mean single-view token, fitted on 12 training scans). `ablate`: its component set to the capture mean. `rand`: the same edit along a random direction (mean of three). `plus` / `minus`: every patch token shifted by one inter-class distance. p: paired sign-flip over scans, ablate against rand.
